## 2. SERVICES & CONFIRMED BASELINE PRICING

Marine Creatures provides professional, white-glove engineering, installation, and biological restoration services for high-end residential estates, luxury penthouses, corporate headquarters, and hospitality venues.

### 2.1 Turnkey Bespoke Marine Aquarium Installation & Commissioning
- **URL:** https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/installation
- **Pricing:** Turnkey bespoke commissions start from ₹35,000 INR (baseline starting price for design, structural verification, Schedule 80 plumbing, and biological commissioning; total cost scales with tank volume, optical glass/acrylic specifications, and livestock selection).
- **Service Area:** Kolkata Metropolitan Area and West Bengal.
- **Inclusions:**
  1. Structural engineering review & floor load weight distribution analysis (supporting 1,000+ kg/m²).
  2. OptiWhite ultra-clear low-iron glass or thermoformed monolithic acrylic panel placement.
  3. Whisper-quiet Schedule 80 PVC hard-plumbing with true union check valves and dual BeanAnimal fail-safe drains.
  4. Bio-active living rock scaping and high-purity aragonite substrate bedding.
  5. Reverse osmosis (0-TDS RO/DI) water synthesis with calibrated laboratory-grade reef salt.
  6. 14-day automated biological nitrogen cycling with beneficial bacterial culture seeding.
  7. Hand-selected, quarantine-acclimated marine livestock introduction.
  8. Smart IoT application pairing for automated photoperiod and pump control.

### 2.2 Marine Aquarium Renovation & Biological Restoration
- **URL:** https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/renovation
- **Pricing:** Restorations start from ₹15,000 INR (baseline starting price for on-site forensic diagnostic, chemical rebalancing, and equipment overhaul; scales with tank dimensions and scope of hardware modernization).
- **Service Area:** Kolkata Metropolitan Area and West Bengal.
- **Inclusions:**
  1. Complete water chemistry diagnostic and toxic compound lab panel (testing Salinity, pH, dKH, Ca, Mg, NO3, PO4).
  2. 100% Zero-Loss Livestock Relocation Protocol: Existing fish and delicate corals are housed in mobile, climate-controlled, oxygenated staging pods during tank restoration.
  3. Optical acrylic/glass scratch removal and diamond-compound polishing without tearing down existing architectural cabinetry or millwork.
  4. Complete eradication of nuisance cyanobacteria, dinoflagellates, hair algae, and yellowing organic compounds.
  5. Modernization with silent DC variable-speed return pumps (operating under 28 dB) and app-controlled LED spectrum arrays.
  6. Biological live-rock rejuvenation and microbial reboot to permanently restore water clarity.

### 2.3 White-Glove Marine Concierge Maintenance
- **URL:** https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/services#maintenance
- **Pricing:** Dedicated scheduled maintenance starts from ₹18,500 / Month INR.
- **Service Area:** Kolkata Metropolitan Area (Alipore, Ballygunge, Salt Lake / Sector V, New Town, Southern Avenue, Park Street).
- **Inclusions:**
  1. Bi-weekly on-site care visits by senior marine curators.
  2. Pre-mixed laboratory-grade RO/DI and probiotic salt water changes.
  3. ICP-OES trace element balancing and automated dosing reservoir replenishment.
  4. Protein skimmer neck cleaning, filter media replacement (carbon, synthetic resins), and optical glass detailing.
  5. 24/7 priority emergency rapid-response support for unexpected electrical or equipment disruptions.

- **Hardware & Life Support:** https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/marketplace?category=hardware

## 4. SCIENTIFIC REEF WATER CHEMISTRY STANDARDS

For all marine and reef environments, Marine Creatures maintains and advises the following water parameters:

| Parameter | Recommended Marine Target Range | Testing Cadence |
|---|---|---|
| Specific Gravity / Salinity | 1.025 – 1.026 SG (35.0 ppt) | Weekly via calibrated optical refractometer |
| Water Temperature | 24.5°C – 25.5°C (76°F – 78°F) | Continuous digital monitoring / titanium chiller |
| pH Level | 8.1 – 8.4 | Daily / Continuous probe |
| Carbonate Hardness (Alkalinity) | 8.0 – 9.0 dKH | Bi-weekly titration |
| Calcium (Ca) | 420 – 440 ppm | Bi-weekly titration |
| Magnesium (Mg) | 1,300 – 1,350 ppm | Monthly titration |
| Nitrate (NO3) | 1.0 – 5.0 ppm (Ultra-Low Reef) | Weekly photometric test |
| Phosphate (PO4) | 0.02 – 0.05 ppm | Weekly photometric test |
| Ammonia (NH3/NH4+) | 0.0 ppm (Undetectable) | Tested during cycling & quarantine |
| Nitrite (NO2-) | 0.0 ppm (Undetectable) | Tested during cycling & quarantine |
